description:
Enables users to bring their own precompiled WebAssembly modules (.wasm) and execute them
        as actions, conditions, triggers, variables, or results within weave workflows. Uses
        the Extism plugin protocol via chicory-sdk (pure-Java WASM runtime). Supports any language
        with an Extism PDK: Rust, Go, AssemblyScript, C, Zig, and more.
